calibration.notes: 6.35 mm burner sphere; 98 +/- 1 px on 19254C1 (frames flame_on+2..3 s); sigma widened to include the observed +/-2.5 % between-test spread of the method (103 px on 19304A7).

radius_noise_check.note: Observed value is the robust scatter of r about its smoothed curve; it underestimates noise slightly because the smoother absorbs some of it, and it excludes systematic bias.

extinction.message: Flame not detected in the final 15 analysed frames.

quantity_notes: Pixel quantities are image-derived from a 2-D projection.
Millimetre quantities are calculated with the supplied calibration scale.
equivalent_volume_mm3 assumes a spherical flame; it is not a 3-D measurement.
Uncertainties include boundary localisation and calibration scale only.

issues.message: dark frame = median of first 10 frames
8-bit scale: 3964 dark-subtracted counts = 255 (99.95 percentile over every 10th frame, 4 saturated sample frame(s) excluded)
Frame intervals vary by up to 162.8% of the median (86.000 ms); per-frame timestamps are used for all time derivatives.

experiment_id.description: Experiment identifier supplied by the caller.

frame_index.description: Zero-based index of the decoded frame in the video.

timestamp_s.description: Presentation time relative to the first decoded frame.

confidence.description: segmentation_quality x tracking continuity (not a probability).

segmentation_quality.description: contour dominance x clipped local contrast (not a probability).

contrast.description: (mean inside - mean of 5 px outer ring) / 255.

n_candidates.description: Contours passing the minimum-area and local-contrast filters.

threshold.description: Global threshold used (Otsu/fixed); empty for local/colour methods.

centroid_x_px.description: Area centroid x of the filled flame region.

centroid_y_px.description: Area centroid y of the filled flame region.

equivalent_radius_sigma_px.description: 1-sigma random uncertainty of the equivalent radius.

area_px2.description: Projected flame area (pixel count of the filled contour).

ellipse_major_px.description: Major axis length of the least-squares ellipse.

ellipse_minor_px.description: Minor axis length of the least-squares ellipse.

boundary_roughness.description: std / mean of boundary distance from centroid.

touches_border.description: Flame region touches the image edge (size underestimated).

radius_sigma_mm.description: Random and scale uncertainty combined in quadrature.

equivalent_volume_mm3.description: (4/3) pi r^3 - equivalent SPHERICAL estimate, not a 3-D measurement.

expansion_velocity_px_s.description: dr/dt from timestamp-aware local polynomial fit.

centroid_displacement_px.description: Distance of centroid from the first accepted centroid.

limb_radius_px.description: Shell-limb radius: RANSAC circle fit to outer half-maximum edges (radius_method=limb).

limb_radius_sigma_px.description: Bootstrap fit uncertainty and edge localisation (edge_sigma_px) in quadrature.

limb_coverage.description: Fraction of angular sectors contributing a limb edge (partial shells < 1).

limb_arc_deg.description: Angular span of the limb edge points used in the fit.

limb_rms_px.description: RMS distance of inlier edge points from the fitted circle.

limb_fit_ok.description: Fit sufficient: >= 8 inliers, arc >= 90 deg, coverage >= 40 %, RMS <= max(2 px, 3 % R), not saturated.

limb_radius_sigma_mm.description: Random and calibration-scale uncertainty in quadrature.

warnings.description: Per-frame notes and warnings, '; '-separated in CSV.
